conversations_direct_ck.name: conversations_direct_ck
conversations_direct_ck.value: "conversations"."kind" <> 'direct' or ("conversations"."member_a" is not null and "conversations"."member_b" is not null)

events_host_ck.name: events_host_ck
events_host_ck.value:
("events"."host_type" = 'member' and "events"."host_member_id" is not null and "events"."host_chapter_id" is null and "events"."host_organisation_id" is null)
        or ("events"."host_type" = 'chapter' and "events"."host_chapter_id" is not null and "events"."host_member_id" is null and "events"."host_organisation_id" is null)
        or ("events"."host_type" = 'organisation' and "events"."host_organisation_id" is not null and "events"."host_member_id" is null and "events"."host_chapter_id" is null)

events_external_ck.name: events_external_ck
events_external_ck.value: "events"."registration_mode" = 'internal' or ("events"."capacity" is null and "events"."external_url" is not null)
